# botyard_pack (Data Source)

Looks up one pack in the organization's bot catalogue by slug and returns a summary of its latest published version. Read the version's contents (skills, tools, connections, settings) with `botyard_pack_version`.

Archived packs, and packs with no published version, are not in the catalogue and are reported as not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a catalogue pack and its latest published version.
data "botyard_pack" "crm" {
  slug = "crm-assistant"
}

output "crm_latest_version" {
  value = data.botyard_pack.crm.latest.version_no
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the pack to look up.

### Read-Only

- `latest` (Attributes) Summary of the pack's latest published version. The catalogue lists only the latest version of each pack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--latest))
- `pack_id` (String) Unique pack identifier (UUID).
- `publisher_org_id` (String) Organization that publishes the pack. Null for platform-curated packs.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see the pack: `curated`, `org_private` or `public`.

<a id="nestedatt--latest"></a>
### Nested Schema for `latest`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the version's avatar image.
- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the version's contents. Changes whenever the contents do.
- `created_at` (String) When the version was published (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Display name of this version.
- `pack_version_id` (String) Id of the pack's latest published version. Pass it to `botyard_pack_version`.
- `summary` (String) One-line summary of this version.
- `version_no` (Number) Version number, counting from 1.
